description.en:
Removes one character from the party with the leaving presentation. For each character, the sound effect sys_021 plays (CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE(21)), the system message "sysmes-remove_party" is shown with the character's name filled in, then the character is removed; the next one waits until the sound has finished.
The BGM is first stopped with a fade of 30, then the function waits 45 frames; once everyone is removed, the BGM plays again with a fade of 30 and the function waits 30 more frames.
It is RemoveParty_MessageEx(1, [_paramID], [_flg_st_reset], 30, 45, 21, 0, "sysmes-remove_party", _not_pt_lock).
Parameter ID of the character to remove, e.g. "para_cp0010".
true to also delete the character's saved record, so they start over if they join again. The shipped calls pass false.
true to call RemovePartyCmnd(id, reset, false) instead of RemoveParty(id, reset); see RemoveParty for the difference.

examples.case: A member leaving the team (real usage, from ev42090900.nut)
